# Middle Grade Ninja

> > A podcast and content platform dedicated to middle-grade fiction, hosted by Rob Kent, featuring author interviews, publishing industry insights, and writing craft guidance.

Middle Grade Ninja is a comprehensive resource for aspiring and published middle-grade authors, featuring a podcast available on major platforms (Spotify, Stitcher, SoundCloud, iTunes, Podbean) and interview series with industry professionals. The site combines Rob Kent's personal insights with conversations from notable authors, literary agents, and editors.

## Podcast & Core Content

- [Middle Grade Ninja: Podcast](https://middlegradeninja.com/p/podcast): Middle Grade Ninja podcast episodes with author interviews and writing craft

- [Middle Grade Ninja: Podcast Episodes](https://middlegradeninja.com/middle-grade-ninja-podcast-3): Podcast episodes featuring author interviews and publishing professionals

## Author & Professional Interviews

- [Author Interviews](https://middlegradeninja.com/p/interviews-with-writers): 7 Questions interview series with authors like Tomi Adeyemi and Richard Adams
- [Interviews with Literary Agents](https://middlegradeninja.com/p/interviews-with-literary-agents): 7 Questions interviews with agents Uwe Stender, Mark Gottlieb, Joanna Volpe
- [Interviews with Editors](https://middlegradeninja.com/middle-grade-ninja-interviews-with-editors): 7 Questions interviews with editors Kendra Levin, Erin Clarke, Frances Gilbert
- [7 Questions For: Author Julie E. Czerneda](https://middlegradeninja.com/page/2): 7 Questions interview with Julie Czerneda on science fiction and book series

## Guest Posts & Writing Advice

- [Guest Posts](https://middlegradeninja.com/p/guest-posts): Guest posts from authors on writing advice and middle-grade fiction craft
- [Guest Post: Why Literary Agent Joanna Volpe Loves Middle Grade](https://middlegradeninja.com/middle-grade-ninja-guest-post-why-literary-agent-joanna-volpe-loves-middle-grade): Joanna Volpe guest post on middle-grade publishing and query submissions
- [Ninja Stuff](https://middlegradeninja.com/p/ninja-stuff): Writing advice, editing craft, and author interviews with Rob Kent
- [Toy Story 3 and Darkness in Children's Stories](https://middlegradeninja.com/middle-grade-ninja-toy-story-3-and-darkness-in-childrens-stories): Analysis of darkness themes in children's stories using Toy Story 3 example
